propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion-verifier runs exhaust the bounded request budget with zero incrementally banked criterion verdicts instead of the promised evidence-backed PASS/FAIL outcome
Pydantic AI executes tool batches concurrently per response, so prompt-only instructions cannot enforce serialized evidence collection and record calls are deferred until budget exhaustion

A completion-only policy wrapper must atomically claim one governed repository action per run_step, count unique evidence responses per criterion, and invoke provisional met=false banking on the third evidence response if still unbanked

The finite banking contract must be expressed as an authoritative system-level state machine in the verifier prompt rather than relying on untrusted ticket context or subjective evidence sufficiency judgments

The original 9895-aa2c-8907-4db6 run demonstrated 0 bank writes after 24 requests and 37 repository actions; the same dense context with explicit finite-loop authority produced 5/5 tool-origin banks and normal PASS verdict
